test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 26 May 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined word in the given sentence.**

Due to his hard work, he established a __succesful__ career.
solution:
The correct answer is **successful.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **spelling **of successful is incorrect in the given sentence.
 
• **Successful:** having achieved what one wanted.
 
• Thus, the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined word in the given sentence is **successful**. 

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 1.**
